description: Assign property values to reinforcement property \(i\) .

keywords.name: rupture-axial-strain
keywords.description: Axial rupture strain. If axial strain exceeds this value, the element will no longer carry axial load.

keywords.name: rupture-shear-strain
keywords.description: Shear rupture strain. If shear strain exceeds this value, the element will no longer carry shear load.

keywords.name: yield-shear-force
keywords.description: Ultimate shear capacity [F]. The element cannot sustain shear forces greater than \(f\) .

keywords.name: yield-tension-force
keywords.description: Ultimate axial capacity [F]. The element cannot sustain axial forces greater than \(f\) .
